matchup.plan_md:
**Matchup 2 is final: lost 1,464 to 1,705.** Matchup 3 against Melbourne poopoo projects **1,461 to 1,487** as rostered. The owner keeps Anthony Black (`council/sessions/20261101-040000-second-stream-slot.json`, owner_decision), so only VanVleet's slot streams.

**The moves: 3 adds, +88.9**, ending the week holding Nurkic (*Rotating* section):

| # | US day | Deadline, Melbourne (ET) | Move |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Thu 5 | **1:00 pm Fri 6** (9:00 pm Thu) | Drop Fred VanVleet, add **Collin Gillespie** (PHX) |
| 2 | Fri 6 | **11:30 am Sat 7** (7:30 pm Fri) | Drop Gillespie, add **Peyton Watson** (CLE) |
| 3 | Sun 8 | **11:00 am Mon 9** (7:00 pm Sun) | Drop Watson, add **Jusuf Nurkic** (UTAH) |

- **Watson** has right hamstring soreness, a Grade 2 strain last season, and a Friday–Saturday back-to-back.
  - If he isn't playing Friday, take Friday's next-best streamer: Santi Aldama (+32), Daniel Gafford (+31) or Naji Marshall (+31) (*Best streamer each day*).
  - Watson: 27.0 (6); L7 30.0 (5), L15 27.0 (6), L30 27.0 (6). The rest of the form is in the tables below.
- **Nurkic** has no games this season. He averaged 36.7 over 41 games in 2026. His re-evaluation is due about 4 Nov, with no result yet (*ESPN est.* 4 Nov). If he isn't cleared, Sunday's next-best adds are Claxton (+33), Aldama (+32) and Missi (+32).
- **The 4-add row (+98.7)** gains 9.8 more, but it drops Nurkic after one game.
- **Lineups:** Monday is overfull (12 of ours for 10 slots), so sit Murphy and Bane. After Monday, start everyone with a game.
- **Watch for:**
  - **Trey Murphy III** (ours): bilateral patellar tendinopathy, probable for Monday; no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 2 Nov.
  - **Dejounte Murray** (ours): off the injury report and expected back Monday.
  - **Kawhi Leonard** (ours): re-evaluated about 3 Nov; *ESPN est.* 23 Nov.
  - **Jalen Duren** (ours, IR): *ESPN est.* 9 Nov.
  - **Melbourne poopoo:** Ty Jerome is off the injury report. Brandon Ingram has been assigned to the G League with no date, and no timetable is reported (*ESPN est.* 8 Nov). Anthony Davis has a Friday–Saturday back-to-back, with no rest reported.
- **Trades:** our seven pending offers all send Black, and most also send VanVleet. See `council/sessions/20261102-070000-black-offers.json`. If one goes through, this plan changes.

### Notes

- **Murphy** is listed probable for Monday against Memphis [CBS Sports, 1 Nov](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/pelicans-trey-murphy-probable-for-monday/). **Dejounte Murray** is not on the injury report [CBS Sports, 1 Nov](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/pelicans-dejounte-murray-not-listed-on-injury-report/).
- **Watson** has right hamstring soreness and is questionable for Monday against OKC [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nba/players/26779136/peyton-watson/fantasy/).
- **Gillespie** played 33 minutes with 16 points, 10 assists and 4 steals off the bench on 30 Oct [CBS Sports, 31 Oct](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/suns-collin-gillespie-tallies-16-points-from-bench/).
- **Brunson** scored 24 on 30 Oct [CBS Sports, 31 Oct](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/knicks-jalen-brunson-tallies-24-points-in-fridays-loss/). **Towns** is playing through a left wrist sprain [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nba/players/2152531/karl-anthony-towns/).
